text: Good morning! Do not touch anything. We have a case!
Someone ate my strawberry yogurt last night. It was the last one.
Impossible. I never forget yogurt. Now, look at this spoon in the sink.
It is clean, but there is a small pink drop on it. Someone washed it in a hurry.
Interesting. And where were you at midnight?
Hmm. Then why is there a pink spot on your sleeve?
We will see. Tomorrow we visit the neighbor. Bring your key!
